pr_title: Introduce a way to show config warnings in swaynag
pr_body:
Closes #3138

Adds the function `config_add_swaynag_warning(char *fmt, ...)` so that handlers can add warnings to the swaynag config log in a uniform way. The formatting is identical to errors and include the line number, line, and config path.

This also alters the background file access warning to use the function and introduces a warning for duplicate bindings.

issue_context.title: Show a swaynag message when two bindings have the same key combination
issue_context.body: Would be nice because it's easy to add a new binding without realizing it's already bound. Need to check if `--locked` is the same too.

review_comments: What happens if this is not executed from the config, e.g. via `swaymsg`?
